doc.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Joe Williams
summary: Gibbs knew Joe Williams from baseball games in Woody Herman's band days and was close on the tour.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Did you get to rub elbows much with Joe Williams?

One of my real — I knew Joe Williams before the Basie band, because when I was with Woody Herman’s band, we had a baseball team. You know we had a team. And we used to play. Joe was with Red Saunders in Chicago and we used to play them in baseball.
Yeah I knew Joe from those days. And Joe and I were really close on the trips. I loved him. We really got along great.
